competency_snapshot.text: Solve problems involving length and distance.

samples_reviewed.question_text: A book is 18 cm long. A shoe is 20 cm long. If they are placed end to end, what is their combined length in cm?
hints: The two lengths join together, so add them.
The total length is 38 centimeter (cm).
